# The module map: every S6 and S7 rule against Teranode (#87)

**Generated by `tools/teranode_map.py` from `corpus/teranode/map.json`; never edited by hand** (`make spec` writes it with the other pages and the spec leg refuses a stale copy; `tools/teranode_map.py --verify` resolves every citation at the pins in the cite leg). [D] 2026-10-14.

The pins `[SRC]`: the reference is bitcoin-sv v1.2.3 `6504a3af`; Teranode is v0.16.0 `4edb60a4` (`docs/PROVENANCE.md` section 1a). Every citation names a file and lines at its pin and the text the verifier finds there. A reference citation reads bitcoin-sv's tree; a Teranode citation reads Teranode's.

**The mechanism column is a reading `[D]`, never a measurement.** `same`: the same decision procedure over the same inputs, read at the two tags; `different`: another structure, stage, trigger or trust root implements the rule; `absent`: one side has no implementation at its tag, and the absent cell cites where it would be. Each row points at exactly one obligation: the refinement relation (#88) discharges it by a theorem or a witness scenario of #66; a `same` row is judged by the per-release divergence report (#95); an `absent` row is ruled in the absence ledger (#96). Policy stays policy: a row about a node's setting names it so (rule 1).

Counts [M]: 54 rows (40 S6, 14 S7); 11 same, 31 different, 12 absent (8 absent in Teranode, 4 absent in the reference); 166 citations.
